protocol: For each one-pass tag order, assign every fitting product to its highest-priority tag and give each tag the exact q-weighted medoid of the labels it heads, breaking ties by integer order. Predict the coefficient of the highest-priority tag that has one, else the medoid of all fitting labels. The pooled variants give each tag the medoid of all of its fitting products and then select by the same order or by the native 71-adic medoid of the active values. The constant row always predicts that default. The sum and medoid references reuse the frozen one-pass fits and must reproduce their archived scores. Average random seeds within each fold, then weight all five folds equally.
